09-title-in-space.reply:
I made a 5-second, 1920×1080 title on a dark navy background, with a few faint stars at different depths. The "DEEP FIELD" title and the "SEASON 2" line (typed as "Season 2", shown in capitals) both stand in a 3D scene. The camera starts close and low on the right, sweeps across to the left, and settles square to the viewer from about 4.1 s, so the last second is a readable hold. The kicker sits in front of the title, so the two separate as the camera moves.

I exported the video as `09-title-in-space.mp4` and saved the project as `09-title-in-space.uve`, both in the bench folder. I looked at frames across the move and at the final frame, not the exported file itself.

The sheen is a soft light band that sweeps across the frame between about 1.3 and 3.1 s. It isn't a real light reflection: the lit material on the title gave no visible highlight, and the shine effect didn't show when applied to the title itself. So I put the shine on the whole 3D layer, which means it also crosses the kicker and stars.
